guard: a person's manager view controls only the agents under their own owner, and their sign-in reads only those agents' event channels, both keyed on the ledger row being interactive and never on a scope token
why: Each mutation is a plausible one-line regression in the grant builders. The smoke imports core's src directly, so no build runs between the mutation and the suite.

mutations.name: a person's manager view loses its seat rows
mutations.expectRed: a person's manager view stops, attaches to, types into and interrupts their own agents

mutations.name: the seat rows key on the spawn scope instead of the row kind
mutations.expectRed: an agent's manager view gets no input or interrupt row

mutations.name: a person's manager view loses its inspect and ps reads
mutations.expectRed: a person's manager view resolves and lists their agents whatever their scope

mutations.name: the seat rows reach every owner
mutations.find: target: { mode: "owner", tOwner: owner } as EpTarget,
mutations.expectRed: a person's manager view holds no any-mode seat row

mutations.name: overlapping sets mint a subject twice
the live event read takes any sender
mutations.expectRed: a person's sign-in subscribes the event channels of every agent under their own owner

mutations.name: the event history read is not granted
mutations.expectRed: a person reads those channels' history through its own lifecycle's reader

mutations.name: every ledger row reads its owner's event channels
mutations.expectRed: an agent's credential and a chat session read no event channel they were not granted

mutations.name: any profile takes a ledger kind
mutations.expectRed: ledgerKind on any other profile is refused
